verdict.rationale: Mastra has reference documentation, an MCP docs server, embedded package docs and llms.txt, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Studio is for testing the user's own agents and workflows, not for exploring the API reference, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
